source_results.v075_key_result: Increasing the preregistered CLASS k sampling from 10/70 to 80/560 left the native-transfer tangent strongly lambda-affine but did not change the transfer-power versus pk_lin discrepancy or the pk_lin tangent non-affinity.

question: Does the matter power reconstructed from CLASS d_m close the CLASS Fourier power on the native common (k,tau) nodes, with the previously observed discrepancy appearing only after the two different off-node time-interpolation operators are applied?

frozen_physical_model.eta0_variational_forcing: same positive-Drude source-grid construction with control order 512 and primary order 1024

native_node_definition.required_grid_identity: native transfer and native Fourier k and z arrays must agree elementwise within fixed numerical tolerances
native_node_definition.primary_native_window: all common native nodes with 0.03 <= k/(h Mpc^-1) <= 0.20 and 0.2 <= z <= 1.5
native_node_definition.source_power_identity: P_source_node=(2*pi^2/k^3)*d_m^2*P_R(k), with k in 1/Mpc and P_R=A_s*(k/0.05 Mpc^-1)^(n_s-1)

off_node_target_paths.source_then_square: Class.get_transfer(z, output_format='class') interpolates d_m in time; reconstruct P_source_target from that d_m and the same primordial identity
off_node_target_paths.fourier_log_power: Class.pk_lin(k,z) returns the CLASS Fourier linear matter spectrum after its stored log-power interpolation
off_node_target_paths.status: diagnostic localization only; the off-node discrepancy itself is not a science pass gate because it is already historically observed in v0.74-v0.75

lambda_affinity_metric: global normalized RMS deviation of each lambda response from the four-lambda consensus over the specified node/window

classification_policy.pass_meaning: The CLASS matter source and Fourier power close, and their eta=0 tangents are lambda-affine, on the common native nodes in the fixed scale/redshift window. This is a numerical source-to-Fourier closure certificate only.
classification_policy.fail_meaning: At least one preregistered native-node/control gate fails. Keep the failure and report the failed gate; do not change the model, grid, tangent amplitudes, numerical thresholds, or interpolation operators as a rescue.

interpretation_policy: Even if the diagnostic localizes the discrepancy to different off-node interpolation operators, this is not observational evidence, does not simulate nonlinear evolution, and does not retroactively rescue any prior version.
